name: Wing Gust
description: Beat both arms like wings and drive a hard gust into the target's chest.

name: Quill Glide
description: Glide over the ground on a light draft with the arms spread like the quills of a bird.

name: Quill Screen
description: Fan the forearms into a screen of layered air that sheds a blow like a wing sheds rain.

name: Raptor Cut
description: Loose a swift raking blade of air that cuts across the target like a raptor's talon.

name: Claw Gust
description: Sweep a clawed draft across the foe's legs and break up its stride.

name: Hawk Reading
description: Hold a keen watch with the sense of the air and mark every small move in the field below.

name: Raptor Dive
description: Rise on a draft and drop onto the foe at speed with a stroke that carries the whole fall.

name: Pinion Storm
description: Beat a storm out of the arms that scatters foes in an arc before and beside the user.

name: Twinwing Gale
description: Beat both wings of the gale at once so that two heavy gusts meet on the foe and burst.

name: Hawkfall Tempest
description: Fall on the foe as two hawks in one storm so that the whole school's weight lands in a single descent.

name: Unadorned Gust
description: Throw a plain flat gust straight from the palm with no flourish and no wasted motion.

name: Silken Glide
description: Glide forward in an even smooth line with the back straight and the head level.

name: Poise Screen
description: Keep a calm screen of air before the chest and let blows exhaust themselves against it.

name: Measured Lash
description: Lash a flat gust exactly onto the foe's weapon arm and knock the weapon off its line.

name: Grave Draft
description: Lay a heavy grave draft upon the foe's shoulders so that it moves with great effort.

name: Exact Cut
description: Cut a thin blade of air to a single chosen point on the target and no other.

name: Hushing Breath
description: Hush the breath to a slow even pace and let the user's qi settle for a precise stroke.

name: Reproving Gale
description: Strike a boastful foe with a stern gale that crushes its guard and keeps its arms low.

name: Sentence Squall
description: Pronounce a squall upon a group of foes and press them to the ground with its weight.

name: Arbiter Cyclone
description: Hold a grave cyclone over the field and let it strike down every foe who tries to rise.

name: Azure Verdict
description: Deliver the school's judging stroke in one exact gale that ends the exchange on the court's terms.

name: Split Gust
description: Split a gust into two streams with the fingers and strike the target with both.

name: Split Glide
description: Glide forward on one stream and sidestep on the other to throw off the foe's aim.

name: Split Screen
description: Hold two separate screens of air at the front and the flank against two lines of attack.

name: Split Listening
description: Listen on two streams of wind at once and tell the sounds of one from the other.

name: Divided Lash
description: Lash out on one track while the body slips down the other and strike twice before the reply.

name: Forked Cut
description: Cut a blade of air that forks in flight and reaches the target by two paths.

name: Branch Rush
description: Rush forward and branch to either side on a draft to strike the foe from the open flank.

name: Dual Breathing
description: Breathe along two tracks at once so the user's guard and strike each hold their own supply of qi.

name: Forked Squall
description: Fork a squall in two and send each half across a different part of the field.

name: Braided Gale
description: Braid two gales round the foe and draw them tight so it cannot turn in either direction.

name: Divided Tempest
description: Flash to two points of the field in one beat and burst a tempest at each of them.

name: Twofold Storm
description: Run the school's two tracks as a single storm that strikes the foes and wraps the user in guard.

name: Flow Gust
description: Let a flowing gust run down the arm and out of the palm into the target.

name: Flow Glide
description: Follow the flow of the air round obstacles in one running curve without checking the pace.

name: Flow Screen
description: Let a sheet of fast air flow in front of the body and wash small blows aside.

name: Winding Draft
description: Wind a draft round a foe's lead leg and tug it out of line.

name: Eddy Lash
description: Lash a small hard eddy at the foe that bursts into several biting gusts on contact.

name: Running Draft
description: Run alongside a steady draft that fills in behind the user and shortens a long approach.

name: Stream Reading
description: Read how the streams of air bend and merge across the field to learn where bodies stand.

name: Torrent Gale
description: Pour a torrent of wind across the field in one long flowing sweep that strikes all it meets.

name: Confluent Squall
description: Gather separate winds into one squall at the foe and ride the combined rush into the fray.

name: Meandering Vortex
description: Wander a vortex across the field in unpredictable turns so that foes cannot step clear of it.

name: Gale Confluence
description: Draw every stream of the field to one point and break them together on the foe in one great blow.

name: Core Gust
description: Send a gust from the core out through the arm and strike the target with the whole body.

name: Core Glide
description: Push the wind from the core into the ground and glide along it a long pace.

name: Core Screen
description: Spin a thick screen of wind out from the core and hold it round the whole body.

name: Heartwind Lash
description: Lash a blade of the core's wind at a distant foe with a snap of the wrist.

name: Coiled Breath
description: Coil the breath inside the core and release it into the limbs for a burst of strength.

name: Core Reading
description: Send the core's wind outward and read the hollow places where a body stops it.

name: Core Cyclone
description: Spin a cyclone out of the core that tears through every foe in a wide ring.

name: Heartwind Mantle
description: Cloak the body in a living mantle drawn from the core that heals no wound but turns many blows.

name: Cored Tempest
description: Pack the core's wind into a single tempest and release it in a thundering burst over the foes.

name: Ascendant Gale
description: Rise from the field on the core's gale and bring the school's storm down on the foes below.

name: Windsworn Palm
description: Strike with a palm bound by the oath and a gust that does not turn from its mark.

name: Windsworn Glide
description: Glide forward on a draft that the oath has bound to the user's heel.

name: Windsworn Guard
description: Hold the oath in the forearm and turn a blow aside with a quick bend of the wind.

name: Pledge Whip
description: Lash out with a cord of air in keeping of the pledge to the wind.

name: Oath Breathing
description: Breathe in the words of the oath and let their weight settle into the user's frame.

name: Plighted Draft
description: Bind a foe's limbs with a plighted draft that holds as long as the user keeps the vow.

name: Altitude Reading
description: Read the thinness of the air to judge height and distance to every body in view.

name: Pledged Gale
description: Call the pledged gale down on a single foe so that it cannot break the user's hold.

name: Vowed Tempest
description: Spread the oath outward as a tempest that falls on each foe who stands against the sworn.

name: Oath Cyclone
description: Turn the oath into a cyclone that circles the user and strikes every foe who comes near.

name: Oathbound Gale
description: Loose the school's oath as a single gale that binds the foe to the moment of its breaking.

name: Long Gust
description: Throw a long hard gust that carries its force over a good distance to the target.

name: Far Stride
description: Take a very long stride on a lifting draft and land with the knees soft.

name: Long Screen
description: Stretch a thin long screen of air in front of the user that catches missiles at a distance.

name: Long Listening
description: Carry sounds over a great distance on a thin wind to the user's ear.

name: Distance Lash
description: Lash a stinging cord of air over a far reach and strike a distant foe on the hand.

name: Far Breath
description: Draw a long deep breath that carries the user's qi and stamina over a lengthy pursuit.

name: Faring Draft
description: Hold a steady following draft and cover great ground without a break or a lost step.

name: Trailing Draft
description: Let the wake of a fast pass drag at a foe's flank and spoil its balance.

name: Far Squall
description: Throw a squall to a far point and let it break there over every foe in range.

name: Farcast Gale
description: Cast a gale across a long distance that arrives unslowed and bursts on the foes at the end.

name: Distant Cyclone
description: Raise a cyclone far from the user and walk it across the ground to the foes.

name: Farreach Storm
description: Gather the long bearing into one storm and loose it over a vast reach in a single throw.

name: Bare Gust
description: Throw a bare dry gust that strips loose cloth and dust from the target.

name: Bare Stride
description: Stride forward in the open without cover and let the wind keep the user upright.

name: Bare Screen
description: Hold a plain bare screen of air against blows from the front and take no other cover.

name: Peeling Draft
description: Strip the foe's grip on its weapon or shield with a hard peeling draft.

name: Unsheltered Cut
description: Cut a keen blade of air at a foe standing without cover and strike it in the side.

name: Open Breathing
description: Breathe wide in the open wind and let the qi run free through every limb.

name: Hard Reading
description: Read the hard wind across open ground and judge where a foe hides from it.

name: Stripping Gale
description: Strip the field with a hard gale that tears cover aside and unbalances the foes behind it.

name: Unsheltered Squall
description: Break a squall over the open ground that harries every foe left without cover.

name: Flaying Tempest
description: Gather a tempest that flays the field of cover and strikes every foe left standing.

name: Sundering Squall
description: Drive the school's stripping wind into one great squall that sunders the field from end to end.

name: High Gust
description: Throw a cold gust from above the shoulder that hammers the target from on high.

name: High Stride
description: Stride high on a pillar of air and land well beyond the foe's reach.

name: High Screen
description: Hold a thin cold screen high overhead that sheds blows from above.

name: Altitude Lash
description: Lash a high cold cord of air downward at a foe far below the user.

name: Thin Breath
description: Breathe the thin cold air and train the body to work hard on little breath.

name: Upper Reading
description: Read the upper winds for storms and for flights of foes crossing in the distance.

name: Highwind Gale
description: Hammer the foe with a gale from the heights that holds it crouched against the ground.

name: High Mantle
description: Spread a cold high mantle of wind over the user that turns blows from every quarter.

name: Highwind Vortex
description: Spin a great cold vortex from the heights that grinds the foes and screens the user.

name: Skyvow Tempest
description: Speak the school's oath at the top of the sky and bring the whole storm down on the foes.

name: Core Draft
description: Throw a hard draft from the core through the palm and into the target.

name: Core Slide
description: Slide along a flat draft thrown from the core and arrive a pace from the foe.

name: Core Cover
description: Pull a dense cover of wind close about the core and keep it there against attacks.

name: Core Hearing
description: Let the core's wind reach outward and hear the faint stir of every breath nearby.

name: Vowfed Lash
description: Lash a cord of air fed by the oath in the core to a distant foe.

name: Core Scour
description: Scour an ally's body with clean wind drawn from the core to lift poison and taint.

name: Inner Draft
description: Run a steady draft through the core and the meridians and sharpen the user's strength.

name: Steady Reading
description: Hold the core steady and read the whole surrounding field without any blur or lag.

name: Vow Cyclone
description: Raise a cyclone from the vow in the core and drive it at the closest foes.

name: Core Mantle
description: Wrap the core's wind round the body as a thick mantle that holds against heavy blows.

name: Core Vortex
description: Spin a vortex out of the core that grinds each foe about it and breaks their formation.

name: Unending Gale
description: Keep the oath's gale blowing without end so the foes break upon it while the user stands unmoved.
